data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2 (cycle 2 plan review feedback): Add explicit AC: the story-branch merge commit MUST include the squashed work of tasks 3 + 4 + 5 + 7 together (atomic merge). No individual task commits from this group may be cherry-picked or merged to main before task-6 completes. This is enforced by the story-branch merge protocol — tasks 3-5-7 are non-deployable in isolation.
